correctness.rationale: An explicit even/odd Petersen-walk formula transfers resolving sets to projections. Exhaustive classification of all four isomorphism types of three-edge simple subgraphs of K5 proves exactly three-star Petersen bases. Unique star center is invariant under a one-landmark exchange; within each center, signed transversals give exact exchange paths of length 3 minus intersection size. The two independent executable graph models verify 160 bases, five 32-vertex 9-regular components, exact distance profile (1,9,15,7), 720 edges and the explicit GP(10,3) model isomorphism.

value.rationale: Boutin’s Petersen exchange-property example motivates the behavior of minimum landmark sets under optimal-size swaps. The complete all-bases classification for the canonical distance-transitive Desargues graph and exact five-component obstruction are natural structural facts not implied by its previously known metric dimension 3. The exact within-component distance formula exhibits a strong, mathematically informative partition-matroid-like structure and distinguishes reachable from unreachable minimum landmark placements.
